name: Iwanka Rump
source:
Daughter of [url=/c111372]Melonia Rump[/url] and [url=/c111374]Ronald Rump[/url].

[spoiler]
On the outside, she shows a loyal and supportive attitude towards her father, but due to the nature of her rich family, she has lived with her parents' excessive interference since she was a child, so she has a rebellious spirit. After chance encounters with the protagonist and his friend Eric, a commoner different from herself, she feels liberated as they party together at Eric's house, and her relationship with the protagonist rapidly narrows in the aftermath. 

She later enters Mayor Rump's yacht, where she goes on a date with the protagonist. She strips off her swimsuit, and dives into the ocean completely nude to seduce him. She gives the protagonist Mayor Rump's office key card. After her father goes to prison, she is completely naked in her room.
[/spoiler]
